verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶה֙ מָק֣וֹר נִפְתָּ֔ח לְבֵ֥ית דָּוִ֖יד וּלְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לְחַטַּ֖את וּלְנִדָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū yih·yeh mā·qō·wr nip̄·tāḥ lə·ḇêṯ dā·wîḏ ū·lə·yō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim lə·ḥaṭ·ṭaṯ ū·lə·nid·dāh
verses.literal: On that day a fountain will be opened to the house of David and the people of Jerusalem to cleanse them from sin and impurity
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, haverá uma fonte aberta para a casa de Davi e para os habitantes de Jerusalém, para remover o pecado e a imundícia.

verses.original: וְהָיָה֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא נְאֻ֣ם׀ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת אַכְרִ֞ית אֶת־ שְׁמ֤וֹת הָֽעֲצַבִּים֙ מִן־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וְלֹ֥א יִזָּכְר֖וּ ע֑וֹד וְגַ֧ם אֶת־ הַנְּבִיאִ֛ים וְאֶת־ ר֥וּחַ הַטֻּמְאָ֖ה אַעֲבִ֥יר מִן־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ḇay·yō·wm ha·hū nə·’um Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’aḵ·rîṯ ’eṯ- šə·mō·wṯ hā·‘ă·ṣab·bîm min- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·lō yiz·zā·ḵə·rū ‘ō·wḏ wə·ḡam ’eṯ- han·nə·ḇî·’îm wə·’eṯ- rū·aḥ haṭ·ṭum·’āh ’a·‘ă·ḇîr min- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: And on that day declares the LORD of Hosts I will erase the names of the idols from the land and they will no longer . . . be remembered I will also remove the prophets and the spirit of impurity from the land
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, diz Jeová dos Exércitos, cortarei da terra os nomes dos ídolos, e deles não haverá mais memória; também farei cessar da terra os profetas e o espírito imundo.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כִּֽי־ יִנָּבֵ֣א אִישׁ֮ עוֹד֒ וְאָמְר֣וּ אֵ֠לָיו אָבִ֨יו וְאִמּ֤וֹ יֹֽלְדָיו֙ לֹ֣א תִֽחְיֶ֔ה כִּ֛י שֶׁ֥קֶר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וּדְקָרֻ֜הוּ אָבִ֧יהוּ וְאִמּ֛וֹ יֹלְדָ֖יו בְּהִנָּבְאֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kî- yin·nā·ḇê ’îš ‘ō·wḏ wə·’ā·mə·rū ’ê·lāw ’ā·ḇîw wə·’im·mōw yō·lə·ḏāw lō ṯiḥ·yeh kî še·qer dib·bar·tā bə·šêm Yah·weh ū·ḏə·qā·ru·hū ’ā·ḇî·hū wə·’im·mōw yō·lə·ḏāw bə·hin·nā·ḇə·’ōw
verses.literal: And if anyone still prophesies his father and mother who bore him will say to him You shall not remain alive because you have spoken falsely in the name of the LORD When he prophesies his father and mother who bore him will pierce him through
verses.literalPt: Se alguém ainda profetizar, seu pai e sua mãe, que o geraram, lhe dirão: Não viverás, porque falas mentiras em nome de Jeová. Seu pai e sua mãe, que o geraram, o traspassarão quando profetizar.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יֵבֹ֧שׁוּ הַנְּבִיאִ֛ים אִ֥ישׁ מֵחֶזְיֹנ֖וֹ בְּהִנָּֽבְאֹת֑וֹ וְלֹ֧א יִלְבְּשׁ֛וּ אַדֶּ֥רֶת שֵׂעָ֖ר לְמַ֥עַן כַּחֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bay·yō·wm ha·hū yê·ḇō·šū han·nə·ḇî·’îm ’îš mê·ḥez·yō·nōw bə·hin·nā·ḇə·’ō·ṯōw wə·lō yil·bə·šū ’ad·de·reṯ śê·‘ār lə·ma·‘an ka·ḥêš
verses.literal: And on that day every prophet who prophesies will be ashamed of his vision and he will not put on a hairy cloak in order to deceive
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, serão envergonhados os profetas, cada um da sua visão, quando profetizar; e não se vestirão de manto de pelos, para enganarem;

verses.original: וְאָמַ֕ר לֹ֥א נָבִ֖יא אָנֹ֑כִי אִישׁ־ עֹבֵ֤ד אֲדָמָה֙ אָנֹ֔כִי כִּ֥י אָדָ֖ם הִקְנַ֥נִי מִנְּעוּרָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar lō nā·ḇî ’ā·nō·ḵî ’îš- ‘ō·ḇêḏ ’ă·ḏā·māh ’ā·nō·ḵî kî ’ā·ḏām hiq·na·nî min·nə·‘ū·rāy
verses.literal: He will say I . . . am not a prophet I work the land for I was purchased as a servant in my youth
verses.literalPt: mas dirá: Não sou profeta, sou lavrador da terra, porque tenho sido feito escravo desde a minha mocidade.

verses.original: וְאָמַ֣ר אֵלָ֔יו מָ֧ה הַמַּכּ֛וֹת הָאֵ֖לֶּה בֵּ֣ין יָדֶ֑יךָ וְאָמַ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֻכֵּ֖יתִי בֵּ֥ית מְאַהֲבָֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar ’ê·lāw māh ham·mak·kō·wṯ hā·’êl·leh bên yā·ḏe·ḵā wə·’ā·mar ’ă·šer huk·kê·ṯî bêṯ mə·’a·hă·ḇāy
verses.literal: If someone asks him What are these wounds on your chest . . . he will answer These are the wounds I received in the house of my friends
verses.literalPt: Alguém lhe perguntará: Que são estas feridas entre os teus braços? Então, responderá ele: As com que fui ferido na casa dos meus amigos.

verses.original: חֶ֗רֶב עוּרִ֤י עַל־ רֹעִי֙ וְעַל־ גֶּ֣בֶר עֲמִיתִ֔י נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת הַ֤ךְ אֶת־ הָֽרֹעֶה֙ וּתְפוּצֶ֣יןָ הַצֹּ֔אן וַהֲשִׁבֹתִ֥י יָדִ֖י עַל־ הַצֹּעֲרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ḥe·reḇ ‘ū·rî ‘al- rō·‘î wə·‘al- ge·ḇer ‘ă·mî·ṯî nə·’um Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ haḵ ’eṯ- hā·rō·‘eh ū·ṯə·p̄ū·ṣe·nā haṣ·ṣōn wa·hă·ši·ḇō·ṯî yā·ḏî ‘al- haṣ·ṣō·‘ă·rîm
verses.literal: Awake O sword against My Shepherd against the man who is My Companion declares the LORD of Hosts Strike the Shepherd and the sheep will be scattered and I will turn My hand against the little ones
verses.literalPt: Desperta, ó espada, contra o meu pastor e contra o homem que é o meu companheiro, diz Jeová dos Exércitos; fere ao pastor, e espalhar-se-ão as ovelhas; e voltarei a minha mão para os pequeninos.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה בְכָל־ הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה פִּֽי־ שְׁנַ֣יִם בָּ֔הּ יִכָּרְת֖וּ יִגְוָ֑עוּ וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁ֖ית יִוָּ֥תֶר בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ḇə·ḵāl- hā·’ā·reṣ nə·’um- Yah·weh pî- šə·na·yim bāh yik·kā·rə·ṯū yiḡ·wā·‘ū wə·haš·šə·li·šîṯ yiw·wā·ṯer bāh
verses.literal: And in all the land declares the LORD two-thirds . . . will be cut off and perish but a third will be left in it
verses.literalPt: Em toda a terra, diz Jeová, duas partes nela serão exterminadas e perecerão; mas a terceira ficará nela.

verses.original: וְהֵבֵאתִ֤י אֶת־ הַשְּׁלִשִׁית֙ בָּאֵ֔שׁ וּצְרַפְתִּים֙ כִּצְרֹ֣ף אֶת־ הַכֶּ֔סֶף וּבְחַנְתִּ֖ים כִּבְחֹ֣ן אֶת־ הַזָּהָ֑ב ה֣וּא׀ יִקְרָ֣א בִשְׁמִ֗י וַֽאֲנִי֙ אֶעֱנֶ֣ה אֹת֔וֹ אָמַ֙רְתִּי֙ עַמִּ֣י ה֔וּא וְה֥וּא יֹאמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·ḇê·ṯî ’eṯ- haš·šə·li·šîṯ bā·’êš ū·ṣə·rap̄·tîm kiṣ·rōp̄ ’eṯ- hak·ke·sep̄ ū·ḇə·ḥan·tîm kiḇ·ḥōn ’eṯ- haz·zā·hāḇ hū yiq·rā ḇiš·mî wa·’ă·nî ’e·‘ĕ·neh ’ō·ṯōw ’ā·mar·tî ‘am·mî hū wə·hū yō·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāy
verses.literal: This third I will bring through the fire I will refine them like silver - and test them like gold - They will call on My name and I will answer them I will say They are My people and they . . . will say The LORD is our God
verses.literalPt: Farei passar a terceira parte pelo fogo, e os purificarei como se purifica a prata, e os provarei como se prova o ouro. Eles invocarão o meu nome, e eu os escutarei. Eu direi: São meu povo; e eles dirão: Jeová é o meu Deus.
